mismatches.item: Recruiting Future: Continuous Improvement In TA
mismatches.line: Before buying a narrow AI tool, explain how its time saving beats the setup and processing time it adds, or de Graaf says it is not time to implement it.
mismatches.source_says: The 'If you can't explain that, then it's not time to actually implement that' test is about cost: 'Does it actually save us that money? Do you actually get that back?' (15:29), after he describes a sourcing tool costing 'a couple hundred a month'. The setup/feeding and list-processing time is a separate point (13:18 to 14:32) about how much time a tool really saves. The bullet merges the two and makes the explain-or-don't-implement test about time versus time.
mismatches.fix: Before buying a narrow AI tool, count the time spent setting it up and processing its output, and if you cannot explain how it earns back its subscription, de Graaf says it is not time to implement it.

mismatches.item: Lenny's Podcast: Why PMs are suddenly valuable again
mismatches.line: When hiring product managers to work on AI models, Doshi wants people with opinions formed from using models daily, who can build an eval themselves.
mismatches.source_says: 'I want PMs who have an opinion um who are playing with these models every day who have their own use cases for how they judge whether a model is really good ... build an eval' (21:24). Having an opinion and playing with models daily are listed side by side; she does not say the opinions are formed from daily use (invented causation).
mismatches.fix: When hiring product managers to work on AI models, Doshi wants people who have an opinion, play with models every day and can build an eval themselves.

mismatches.item: CNBC · news: AI is speeding up recruitment, and putting agency fees under pressure
mismatches.line: Matt Collingwood of VIQU Group sees every reason for agency fees to hold firm or even increase, if the value agencies deliver keeps growing.
mismatches.source_says: 'I see every reason for our fees to hold firm, or even increase, if the value we deliver continues to grow.' He is speaking of VIQU's own fees and value, not agency fees in general.
mismatches.fix: Matt Collingwood of VIQU Group sees every reason for VIQU's fees to hold firm or even increase, if the value it delivers keeps growing.
